title: A quick-builder draft survives a link opened in another browser, and the four quick builders are measured

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: /free-spotlight, /create-a-space, /launch-your-website and /email-marketing keep the draft only in the fq_feature_hold cookie (3 days, lib/feature-builder/hold.ts), with no server copy and no reminder, unlike Launch Your Business (create_space_drafts plus 1h/1d/3d reminders). A magic link opened in another browser lands on /feed with nothing saved. No component under components/frequency/site/pages/feature-builder emits an event. Fix: save to the same draft store with the same reminder rules, and emit start, claim and finish signals through the create-space signal pipe.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
